svg.title: autograd-from-scratch
svg.desc: A computation graph for L = loss(tanh(x @ W + b)): values flow forward, gradients flow back and the labels dL/dW, dL/db and dL/dx appear. Below, the training curve of a 619,904-parameter character-level GPT trained with this engine and NumPy only: validation loss 4.19 to 1.63.
